signals.summary: Peak-August fruit and vegetables driving plated recipes: tomatoes, corn, stone fruit, berries, plus creamy brie and chilled desserts for hot weather.
signals.why_now: Multiple independent food outlets running seasonal roundups this week: Food & Wine '32 Summer Salad Recipes' with tomatoes and corn and '27 Summer Dessert Recipes', Washington Post '6 creamy brie recipes for summer meals' (64h), Serious Eats 'Late-Summer Recipes Before the Season Slips Away' (115h). Squarely seasonal for early August.

signals.summary: The minimalist buttercream 'dot cake' — a plain iced cake decorated only with piped dots — spreading from TikTok into bakeries and mainstream food press, alongside a parallel push into 24+ layer spectacle cakes.
signals.why_now: Independent coverage across outlets and weeks: Good Morning America explainer on viral dot cakes with make-at-home guides, Taste 'most Australian dot cake', NEWS10 on a micro-bakery bringing the dot cake trend to its area, and SMH on 24+ layer cakes (90h). An aesthetic format with weeks of runway.

signals.topic: Pillowy Japanese milk bread & soft Asian bakes
signals.summary: Japanese shokupan milk bread and the wider soft/enriched Asian-bake moment (rice-flour baking) surfacing across mainstream and trade press.
signals.why_now: UA.NEWS 'TikTok has turned Japanese milk bread into a food trend in the UK' (53h) lands alongside Japan Today 'Why rice flour baking is booming in Japan'. Cross-border and highly photogenic, though the fresh-item count is modest this cycle.

signals.summary: Protein continuing to colonise indulgent formats: protein ice cream, high-protein crunchwraps, pork rinds and savoury protein snacks positioned as the summer's defining food-trend axis.
signals.why_now: Forbes 'Protein Ice Cream Is This Summer's Next Food Trend', Baking Business 'Protein, fiber battle for top food trend' (multiple), 'Pork rinds cash in on protein trend', and a viral high-protein crunchwrap upload. Broad and cross-outlet, though building over weeks rather than hours.
